import urllib.request,urllib.error,json
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/console'
checks=[('/register','إنشاء حساب شركة'),('/register?type=reseller','إنشاء حساب ريسيلر'),('/register?reseller=delta-voice','دلتا فويس'),('/forgot-password','نسيت كلمة المرور'),('/login','نسيت كلمة المرور'),('/reset-password?token=bad','رابط الاسترجاع غير صالح')]
results=[]
for path,expected in checks:
  try:
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers={'User-Agent':'OnTrackAuthWebSmoke/1.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=7) as response:
      body=response.read(160000).decode('utf-8','replace')
      results.append({'path':path,'status':response.status,'contains_expected':expected in body,'body_length':len(body)})
  except Exception as e:
    results.append({'path':path,'status':'error','error':type(e).__name__})
print(json.dumps({'routes':results,'all_pass':all(isinstance(x['status'],int) and x['status']==200 and x['contains_expected'] for x in results)},ensure_ascii=False))
